name: slice_remove
declaration: unsafe fn slice_remove < T > (slice : & mut [MaybeUninit < T >] , idx : usize) -> T
documentation:
Removes and returns a value from a slice of all initialized elements, leaving behind one
 trailing uninitialized element.

 # Safety
 The slice has more than `idx` elements.
rules: Every element of `slice` must contain an initialized value of type `T`.
